comment: Differences from the oracle that are understood and not yet fixed. Each entry pins the exact number of failing cases per target; run_diff.py fails on any failure no entry explains and on any count that changed (a fix must update this file). ps3recomp commit: 39a36296.

entries.note: FPSCR[RN] other than round-to-nearest is ignored by fadd/fmul/fdiv/fadds/fmuls/fmadd/frsp/fctiw/fctid/fcfid: results are always rounded to nearest. Games normally keep the PS3 default (nearest); check the game for mtfsf/mtfsfi before relying on this.
fsqrt of a negative number or -inf returns the host's default NaN. x86 produces 0xfff8... (negative), PowerPC 0x7ff8.... arm64's default NaN is already 0x7ff8..., so the Android target matches.
lfs of a single-precision signalling NaN sets the quiet bit (host float->double conversion). The ISA converts without quieting.

stfs converts with a C (float) cast, which rounds, overflows to inf and quiets sNaN. The ISA store conversion takes FRS[0:1] || FRS[5:34] (truncation) for values outside single range and NaNs. Values already rounded to single (frsp, single ops) are unaffected.
A lane whose input is a signalling NaN returns the default NaN 0x7fc00000; the oracle returns the quieted input (0x7fc00001), keeping the payload.
vctuxs of a value in (-1, 0) sets VSCR[SAT]; truncation gives 0, which is in range, so the oracle leaves SAT clear. The result vector itself matches.

With VSCR[NJ]=1 qemu flushes denormal operands of vector float compares to zero; the lifter compares them as they are. Which one the Cell does is NOT established by this oracle: needs RPCS3's interpreter or hardware.
